text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for tenant LumenCorp on dedicated-reserved pool lumen-reserved-01 (dc-west-2) — p95 latency 1.7s (>1.5s), error-rate 5.3% (baseline 0.4%). Alert: reserve_pool_latency_high_1768456789.
PagerDuty: Incident created — Priority: P1 — Assigned to: oncall-sre.ack required.
Alex Chen: Acked via PagerDuty, I'm on the ticket. Looking. :eyes:
Alex Chen: quick check — is this isolated to lumen-reserved-01 or whole dc-west-2?
Mira Patel: metrics show spike attached to lumen-reserved-01 only, other pools steady.
Mira Patel: queries: 
```
SELECT p95_latency, error_rate FROM infra.metrics WHERE pool="lumen-reserved-01" AND ts > now() - 10m;
```
returned p95 1.7s, error_rate 5.3%, qps down ~12%.
PagerDuty: Alex Chen acknowledged the incident at 14:02 UTC.
Alex Chen: grabbing logs from nodes. Running `rwc inspect pool lumen-reserved-01 --since 10m`
Alex Chen: snippet: 
```
2026-03-14T13:59:48Z node-gpu-03 kernel: GPU memory pressure 92%
2026-03-14T14:00:03Z inference: kvcache-miss spike, batching lag 230ms
2026-03-14T14:01:12Z model-server: rpc timeout to kvstore (ETIMEDOUT)
```
Alex Chen: looks like KV cache thrashing + GPU memory pressure. Possibly burst queue overflow after tenant traffic spike.
Mira Patel: LumenCorp did a sudden reload/rollout? Any deployment events?
Jordan (SRE): I see a config push at 13:57 UTC from LumenCorp — they increased concurrency on their side (client-side) and enabled streaming. That would explain higher per-connection memory.
Alex Chen: mitigation plan: 1) enable burst-capacity for lumen-reserved-01 (+2 GPUs) 2) open fallback routing for new requests to dedicated-fallback-west 3) drop QOS for non-critical routes for 10m.
Mira Patel: agree. Also consider temporary kvcache eviction policy change to LRU-aggresive.
Alex Chen: executing scale command: `rwc cluster scale --pool lumen-reserved-01 --add-gpu 2 --reason "auto-page mitigation"`
eng-runtime: scaling job accepted, job id scale-9876, expected ready ~3m.
Alex Chen: enabling fallback route: `rwc route set --tenant lumencorp --fallback dedicated-fallback-west --pct 30` to shift 30% traffic.
Alex Chen: fallback route applied. Monitoring error-rate.
PagerDuty: Escalation to eng-runtime team at 14:05 UTC (no response yet).
Mira Patel: applying kvcache change: `rwc kvcache policy set lumen-reserved-01 --policy lru --max-entries 200000`
Alex Chen: kvcache policy applied.
Alex Chen: after scale + cache change + fallback shift: p95 down to 1.1s, error-rate 1.2% in last 2m.
Jordan (SRE): nice. Customer impact estimate: ~17k requests in last 15m, ~42% experienced >1s latency, ~2% had transient 500s. Need to notify CS and do RCA.
Mira Patel: I've DM'd CS and Solutions. Recommend contacting LumenCorp PM to confirm they didn't intentionally increase concurrency.
Alex Chen: leaving runbook notes — will keep monitoring for 20m. If p95 < 0.9s and errors <0.5% for 20m we can close.
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Alex Chen, escalation responded by eng-runtime (via scaling job).
eng-runtime: we see one node (node-gpu-03) with memory leak-ish patterns — core dump captured, will open runtime bug ticket. For now scale + eviction is holding.
Jordan (SRE): handing off to Mira for next 30m. Jordan OOO 14:20-15:00 UTC.
Mira Patel: taking over. Notes: monitor scale-9876, fallback route, kvcache health. If re-spike, plan B is full tenant failover to another region (requires CS approval).
Alex Chen: thanks — leaving the Slack thread and PD notes up to you. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident updated — status: monitoring.
incident-bot: If metrics remain stable, auto-resolve scheduled in 25m.
Mira Patel: will post final summary once resolved.
PagerDuty: Incident updated at 14:12 UTC — added note: scale applied, fallback routing at 30%, kvcache LRU applied.
Mira Patel: verified p95 0.85s, errors 0.3% over last 5m. Closing actions: create follow-up ticket for eng-runtime to investigate node-gpu-03 memory behaviour, CS outreach to LumenCorp, runbook add: detect sudden client concurrency increase.
Mira Patel: marking incident as resolved in PD, but keeping thread open for notes. :white_check_mark:
